zh: 新增三个内置组件：翻页时钟、表盘与热力图。时钟把时与分逐格翻页、秒用数字滚动，可按 IANA 时区名显示；表盘用环形比例表示配额与目标，支持四种色调；热力图按日铺格子，按盒子宽度显示 16、26 或 53 周，并给出总数、有记录的天数与连续天数。
en: Adds three built-in widgets: a flip clock, ring gauges and a heatmap. The clock flips hours and minutes cell by cell and rolls the seconds, and takes an IANA time zone; the gauges show quotas and goals as rings in four tones; the heatmap lays out daily cells across 16, 26 or 53 weeks by box width and reports totals, active days and a streak.
